title: Saved project conversations: named text conversations in a project, their members' messages, reply requests, withdrawal and erasure
why: The Studio's conversations (Luis's C1-C9) run against the UI proposal its vision.ts names A18 (issue #105), answered only by fixtures. A18 is a proposal label, not a backend number: this amendment is the real contract (CON-01 binding map §1, §3). Authored as A16 after PR #190's A15; renumbered A33 on integration with main (FND-P-NAMESPACE-01 revision 2), whose A16 is pending invitations.

The four proposed operations keep their paths and meanings. Added: an order (seq) and a cursor bound to its conversation; a reply request on the message that asked, and the request an answer settles (never 'any later Sophia message'); the saved-text policy and the reader's capability; coverage for the summary and the recorded open questions; withdrawal and erasure (CON-01 binding map §3-§7).
The actor, the author's name and the project are the server's: a body naming them is refused (additionalProperties false).

Added after PR #199's review (CON-01-CC-0072, CX-0074): getConversationMessages answers not_found alike to a member reading an erased conversation and to a reader no longer in the project, so the Studio can't tell them apart. getProjectConversationMessages reads within the project in one snapshot: a non-member is refused (403) before anything of the conversation is read; to a current member, not_found means none open in that project. The earlier path keeps its meaning.

CON-01 PhaseB Step2: five capability-only runtime operations bind the actual reply-owned create command and current bridge lease. No body-supplied actor/project/resource, provider execution permission or allowance reset. Amounts use safe JSON integers; actual finite grants and provider bounds remain separately qualified. Acknowledgements report eight durable predicates, never host/process cleanup proof. A04 bindings/commands and other mission schemas are unchanged at this step.

CON-01 Step3 source: exclusive reply ownership, reply-only retire and complete500goal+2reply hello/readiness. Handoff11 approved source-only recovery metadata preserves original goal rows, reports original current-runtime create identity or explicit unresolved state, and cannot expand runtime ACK authority. Native child/process/provider qualification and activation remain separate.

text.description: The message's opening as written, up to 140 characters, line breaks kept.

seq.description: The opening message's own place in its conversation (the newest message not withdrawn). Optional: an API that doesn't say it leaves a reader to match the row by writer, actor and time.

value.description: A conversation's newest message that is not withdrawn: who, when and how it opens.

state.description: not_assessed: none exists (never produced, or removed for privacy). current: it read through the newest eligible message at the project's current ledger revision. stale: still eligible, with newer messages or a moved ledger since. unavailable: the last attempt failed; an earlier eligible projection, if any, stays with its own range.

complete.description: Every eligible message from the first through throughSeq was read; false means partial (a truncated window).

value.description: What a conversation's summary or recorded open questions cover (CON-01 binding map §3.1). A projection that read withdrawn or ineligible text is removed (not_assessed), never shown as stale.

contributors.description: Members who wrote here (messages not withdrawn), in order of their first message; never everyone who can read. At most 200: the first to write, except that the reader, whenever they wrote here, is always among them (in the last place kept when they first wrote later). 200 names means there may be more.

sophia.description: Sophia's answer is published here (one not withdrawn).

messageSeq.description: The highest place any message of this conversation has ever taken, withdrawn ones included, read with the rest of this row. It is an order a reader has observed, not proof that a message is still eligible. Optional: an API that doesn't say it leaves a reader to order a receipt by lastAt.

value.description: One of the project's text conversations as listed: its own history, the project's context.
Sophia asked about one member's message: its own state and, answered, the message that answers it. Only this request's answer settles it.

A message, a member's or Sophia's, in the conversation's own order (seq). Withdrawn, it keeps its place and author kind and nothing of its text or name. A member's message that asked Sophia carries its request (ask); Sophia's names the request it answers (replyTo).
The saved-text policy the project's conversations are under, with the notice shown before a first message.
What the reader may do here now. Advisory: every write is checked again when made.

more.description: More conversations exist than are listed (the newest 200 are).

anyOf.description: Reads the page before this one; bound to this conversation.

cursor.description: The project's feed position this receipt is current at: read in the start's own transaction, after its write and its read-back, under the project lock it holds. Every later event has a higher position.

get.summary: The project's conversations, newest activity first (at most 200), with the saved-text policy and what the reader may do. Members read, viewers included; nobody else. Erased conversations are not listed. Without the project's setting the list is empty and nothing may be written.

403.description: Not permitted (not a member; not a writer; conversations not turned on or read-only: conversations_closed)

422.description: Request fails the declared schema or semantic field constraints; a conversation or message the caller cannot see is not_found

503.description: Dependent service unavailable, or the write's outcome is unknown: retry with the same Idempotency-Key

403.description: Not permitted: the caller is not a current member of the project, or there is no such project. Said before anything of the conversation or the cursor is read, so a non-member learns nothing of either.

422.description: Request fails the declared schema, or its cursor is another conversation's (invalid_request); or, to a current member of the project only, no open conversation with this id is in it (not_found: erased, missing or another project's alike, which this read does not tell apart).

post.summary: Withdraw a message: its author their own (whatever their role now), an admin any. Its text and name go; so do Sophia's answers whose context reached it, and open requests that would read it are cancelled. Works while conversations are read-only. Once per Idempotency-Key.
